summary: No incorrect, incomplete, ambiguous or generator-defect questions found in the 96 reference-checked families (32,293 typed questions, exhaustive). 16 choice-letter families (4275 questions) are unsupported because the option lists are not exported.
refNotes: All 96 references are exhaustive (every released typed question). Every reference reads only the prompt text and the exported figure (tables, bar values, class labels); none uses the stored answer or generator code.

Figure/prompt consistency was checked as part of each reference: pictograph keys and half-picture units, bar values multiples of the scale, tally-mark syntax, pie angles sum 360 and written fractions match angles, histogram/class boundaries, prompt totals vs table totals, probabilities summing to 1, densities normalised, Venn regions non-negative (asadd3, asaddp), triples of probabilities consistent. A violation would have been reported as a mismatch; none occurred.

Probability references enumerate outcomes (itertools over dice/spinner pairs, ordered draws with labelled objects, combinations, permutations of people/digits, population of 10000 equally likely items for Bayes/conditional, 100x100 product space for independent events, convolution of Bernoulli trials for the binomial).

Statistics: means/medians/modes recomputed from the exported tables; grouped median read from the ogive (linear interpolation of the cumulative polygon at n/2), not the textbook formula; grouped mode uses the textbook modal-class interpolation formula (l + (f1-f0)/(2f1-f0-f2) h) - formula based, a modal-class tie would be reported ambiguous (none occurs); empirical relation mode = 3 median - 2 mean is the textbook identity. Variances/mean deviations are population (divide by n), matching the prompts' wording (distribution of the table), and the stored values equal that definition.

Vectors: cos(theta) via the law of cosines cross-checked with the dot formula; cross products checked perpendicular and with Lagrange's identity; a x (b x c) cross-checked with the BAC-CAB identity; Heron cross-check for triangle area; section formula checked coordinate-wise (PR:RQ = m:n). 'Projection of a on b' is the scalar projection a.b/|b| (the answer type is a single exact value; the word-problem form says 'component of F along b'), so this reading is used and is consistent with the stored keys.

Matrices: inverse by exact Gauss-Jordan and checked A A^-1 = I; adjugate checked A adj(A) = det I; rank by exact elimination and SymPy; parametric systems solved with SymPy linsolve and the answer tuple substituted into every equation; aqcpar asks lambda for singularity (det vanishes) or mu for infinitely many solutions (rank condition), both derived by rank/determinant, so the statement is well posed.

Multiple-choice (':mc') forms: 31,993 presentations checked by the runner (exactly one option equals the derived answer and it is the keyed one): 0 bad. Word forms: 24,245 answers equal the typed answers (0 differ). Word-form WORDING was not verified exhaustively; I read one word prompt for each of about 75 families with a word form (and several for those whose numbers are re-expressed: atindt, asaddp, asadd3, attotal, anfreq, apinv2, asbinom, avmiss, atlin, atmag, anwmean, atcross, akmed) and found each a faithful restatement of the typed problem (same quantities, same asked quantity).

Negative controls: the kit's comparison was tested to reject altered tuples, matrices, sets (and report an omitted element as incomplete), expressions differing by a constant, and permuted components.

Reference bugs found and fixed during development (not registered): akgroup class parse included the '(so 20 goes in 20-30)' remark; atproj vector parse swallowed the second vector; avcond decimal regex; akdice range cross-check for equal-range spinners; aqcpar lambda token; plural 'buses' in adbar; akhist threshold regex.
Choice-letter families: see unsupported.json and choice_consistency.json (script refs/stats_prob_vec_mat_choice_consistency.py).
